title: Vladik and fractions
statementMd:
Vladik and Chloe decided to determine who of them is better at math. Vladik claimed that for any positive integer $*n*$ he can represent fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c2954a9b673b8c8ecdb35e61f72ab6c1fa6069ad.png) as a sum of three distinct positive fractions in form ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73b471e9aa68eb411c798a43effc25523c815c83.png).

Help Vladik with that, i.e for a given $*n*$ find three distinct positive integers $*x*$, $*y*$ and $*z*$ such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/637d7258208fe971109fefd332c21093948eb758.png). Because Chloe can't check Vladik's answer if the numbers are large, he asks you to print numbers not exceeding $10^{9}$.

If there is no such answer, print `-1`.

## Input

The single line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$).

## Output

If the answer exists, print $3$ distinct numbers $*x*$, $*y*$ and $*z*$ ($1 ≤ *x*, *y*, *z* ≤ 10^{9}$, $*x* ≠ *y*$, $*x* ≠ *z*$, $*y* ≠ *z*$). Otherwise print `-1`.

If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
Vladik 和 Chloe 决定比一比谁的数学更好。Vladik 声称，对于任意正整数 $*n*$，他都能将分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c2954a9b673b8c8ecdb35e61f72ab6c1fa6069ad.png) 表示为三个形如 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73b471e9aa68eb411c798a43effc25523c815c83.png) 的互不相同的正分数之和。

请帮助 Vladik，也就是说，对于给定的 $*n*$，找出三个互不相同的正整数 $*x*$、$*y*$ 和 $*z*$，使得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/637d7258208fe971109fefd332c21093948eb758.png)。由于 Chloe 无法检查数字过大的答案，Vladik 要求你输出不超过 $10^{9}$ 的数字。

如果不存在这样的答案，请输出 `-1`。

## 输入格式

一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$）。

## 输出格式

如果答案存在，输出 $3$ 个互不相同的数 $*x*$、$*y*$ 和 $*z*$（$1 ≤ *x*, *y*, *z* ≤ 10^{9}$，$*x* ≠ *y*$、$*x* ≠ *z*$、$*y* ≠ *z*$）。否则输出 `-1`。

如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。
